params.active: Engages tossing: when on, plays from the read head jumped back by Slices Back. Pads override this momentarily.
params.offset: How many tempo-locked slices behind 'now' the read head jumps when tossing.
params.division: Slice length on the tempo grid: 0=1/4, 1=1/8, 2=1/8T, 3=1/16, 4=1/32.
params.loop: When on, repeats the jumped slice (stutter). When off, plays through the buffer from the jump point (delay throw).
params.ratchet: Subdivides the loop window for faster repeats (0=full slice, each step halves it).
params.freeze: Stops recording so the buffer holds, looping the captured audio.
params.mix: Wet/dry balance of the tossed signal against the live input.
params.bpm: Fallback tempo used when the host clock is unavailable (e.g. the browser). On device the host tempo wins.
params.xfade: Declick crossfade length in milliseconds applied at every read-head jump and loop seam.
